headline: Recommended extending Hannaford Bros. Co. lease at 39 Florida Avenue
summary: The committee discussed a proposed third amendment to the lease with Hannaford Bros. Co., LLC at 39 Florida Avenue. Councilors asked about kitchen lease rates and the length of the extension period. The committee voted to recommend extending the lease.
decisions: Recommended extending the lease with Hannaford Brothers Amended Lease to 39 Florida Avenue.

decision_evidence.quote: Councilor Fish moved that the Committee recommends extending the lease with Hannaford Brothers Amended Lease to 39 Florida Avenue. Seconded by Councilor Faloon. Vote unless doubted, no doubt.

plain_text:
BUSINESS & ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMITTEE
Monday, August 17, 2026 @ 5:15 PM
Council Chambers, First Floor of City Hall
MEETING MINUTES
City Councilors Present: Leonard, Faloon, Mallar, Fish, Carson, Hawes, Beck,
Walker
City Staff Present: Krieg 
Chair Leonard called the meeting to order at 6:03 P.M.
1. Hannaford Bros. Co., LLC – Third Amendment to Lease, 39 Florida 
Avenue
Chair Leonard introduced the agenda item.
Community and Economic Development Director Krieg presented on the proposed lease
amendment.
Chair Leonard asked the Committee for questions and comments.
Councilor Mallar asked whether the square footage lease rate for kitchens is the same as
for office space – Community and Economic Development Director Krieg confirmed for
this lease, as Hannaford owns the kitchen equipment.
Councilor Fish asked why the extension period is one year -- Community and Economic
Development Director Krieg responded it was in alignment with their request, but she can
explore further.
Councilor Fish moved that the Committee recommends extending the lease with
Hannaford Brothers Amended Lease to 39 Florida Avenue. Seconded by Councilor
Faloon. Vote unless doubted, no doubt.
Meeting adjourned at 6:06 P.M.
Meeting minutes respectfully submitted,
Kayleigh Rienas
Development Assistant
Community & Economic Development Department
